_note: Settings for experiments/v3/run_v3.py. Paths are relative to the repository root. Everything a stage produces lands under experiments/v3/.

llm._extra_models_hint: e.g. ["qwen2.5-14b"]: a larger checkpoint of the best family, about 2x the training time and 30 GB on disk
llm._gpus_hint: one job per listed GPU at a time. Never list four: the A6000 PC trips its PSU and hard-restarts. GPU 2 drives the monitor, so the three usable indices are 0, 1 and 3

judge._rubrics_hint: the first rubric scores the corpus. Calibration on 2026-10-30: the v1 panel agreed best with the human ratings (tier kappa 0.60 vs 0.14 for the checklist panel), so v1 moved to first place; this choice used the calibration ratings, so its kappa is slightly optimistic
